title: Breaking the p-type doping barrier in β-Ga2O3: a GaN-based heterojunction bipolar transistor with high gain, high breakdown, and RF capability
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37518-37531
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07197F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Phuc Hong Than, Tho Quang Than, Yasushi Takaki
Despite extensive research on unipolar β-Ga2O3 semiconductor devices, the advancement of bipolar devices, particularly heterojunction bipolar transistors (HBTs), has been significantly hindered by the lack of reliable p-type doping in β-Ga2O3.
